_metadata.description: SAGE asset-tag → MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise TTP mapping for actor triage surface analysis. Each entry maps one SAGE tag to a TTP observed targeting that surface. Used by BEACON actor_triage to compute Opportunity.victimology_match via surface_ttp_matches.
_metadata.citation_policy: Each entry attributes its prevalence figure or qualitative observation to the source filename and line per [[feedback_ref_md_first]] and [[feedback_external_citations]]. Proprietary vendor table-rows are paraphrased; only statistics and concepts are reproduced (see docs/citations.md).
_metadata.deferred_entries: None. All 35 entries carry ref/ md attribution.
